entry.text: CONFIDENTIAL — ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT — PREPARED FOR US COUNSEL REVIEW. This navigator presents unfiled draft claim-strategy and prior-art passage associations. Do not distribute outside the engagement.

Draft navigation aid generated from claim-set {editionVersion}, the current prior-art comparison matrix, its exact claim/document obligation states, and asserted XML transcription passages. Mappings are applicant-recorded candidates for counsel review — not a novelty, obviousness, disclosure, claim-construction, validity, patentability, or legal opinion. “Counsel review required” states that the matrix records a material relationship for which this passage map has no exact candidate; it does not state that the feature is present or absent. “Reviewed — no material passage required” applies only to the identified matrix field and does not state that the document is irrelevant to another claim or relationship. PDF source evidence remains the fidelity authority, and transcription uncertainty remains visible. This product presents one claim strategy and does not recommend a filing choice.
